note: Chuck-read backside grating gives per-field distortion; doubt: backside in-plane strain differs from front surface under clamping/bending.
Printed-pattern aberration extraction and per-scanner lens/source matching are established scanner practices.
Feed-forward APC for SAQP pitch walk is industry standard; SAOP extension incremental.
Photoacid-sensing fluorophores studied before; additive may hurt 193 nm absorbance and resist performance.
EBID repair throughput per site far too slow for product wafers at volume.
Analytical fingerprint to shortcut ArF resist qualification; supply-chain resilience, not cost/bit.
Per-column capacitance maps as 100% CD metrology; parameters confounded, DRAM test modes partly exist.
Mix-and-match tool assignment by layer tolerance is routine fab practice.
Angled-implant shadow pitch division is published; precise beam-angle metrology is the twist.
Laser THz emission microscopy exists for FA; merging implant masks via screen layers is modest gain.
Wafer-scale slow-positron beam impractical in fab; ZrO2 already low-thermal-budget.
Layer-by-layer XRD control of 100+ Si/SiGe tiers; doubt: in-situ signal/speed for nm-scale layers.
Bevel etch and edge inspection to cut exclusion are widely pursued.
Mid-process laser hammer proxy is novel; doubt: optical carrier injection does not mimic wordline-toggle trap mechanism.
Automated bitmap-to-FIB 3D FA is commercially offered; ramp-time claim optimistic.
Inline laminography with rework-in-place; hybrid-bond dies cannot be thermally released.
Tool-level energy metering and demand response in fabs are known; limited cycle-time slack.
Resistivity-endpoint rinsing and rinse reclaim are already widely deployed.
In-situ diffraction endpoint makes thermal-flow shrink precise; pattern-density loading remains a doubt.
In-pad eddy-current sensing with zone carriers is existing CMP art.
In-situ IR thickness gauging during grinding is commercial; enables thinner dies, smaller TSVs.
